findings.problem: With only the hint "TV, a movie", mirar is also a right answer, since mirar la tele and mirar una película are common in much of Latin America, especially the Río de la Plata region.
findings.fix: hint: a movie, a show (same verb as "to see")

back.es: to see; to watch (TV, a movie)
back.example: Shall we watch a movie tonight?

note: Ver is still the most common way to say watching a movie or TV across Latin America, so the card is worth keeping once the hint rules out mirar.
